newsitem.title: UK: Biotrace in deal with Rentokil.
newsitem.headline: Biotrace in deal with Rentokil.

text.p: British hygiene services company Biotrace International Plc said on Monday it signed an agreement to supply testing systems to Rentokil Hygiene, a unit of Britain's Rentokil Initial Plc.

Biotrace said Rentokil, a pest control, security, healthcare and hygiene group, placed an initial order for 26 systems and tests worth at least 100,000 stg in the first year. The 12-month deal can be extended another three years, Biotrace said.
Rentokil Hygiene would use the Uni-Lite system and Single Shot hygience tests as part of its CaterClean Service initiative being launched this year in Britain, Biotrace said.
